products.name: MultiSymbol TrendEMA RSI EA
products.shortDescription: Multi-symbol EA that trades using higher-timeframe EMA trend, lower-timeframe EMA crossover and RSI confirmation.
products.overview: A multi-symbol Expert Advisor that combines higher-timeframe trend, EMA crossover, and RSI confirmation for cleaner entries. It trades a focused list of 6 symbols (AUDUSD, EURUSD, EURGBP, USDCHF, USDJPY, and DJ30) with solid risk control and no grid or martingale. Higher timeframe (M15) uses EMA 20/50 to define the trend direction. Lower timeframe (M5) waits for an EMA 9/21 crossover in the same direction, confirmed by RSI (above 52 for Buy, below 48 for Sell). Position size is calculated by risk percentage, Stop Loss is based on ATR, and Take Profit follows a Risk:Reward ratio. Includes optional ATR trailing stop, daily loss limit, and maximum open positions protection. A live clickable dashboard shows trend and status for every symbol — click any card to switch the chart instantly.
features: Trades multiple symbols from one chart
Higher TF (M15) EMA 20/50 trend filter
Lower TF (M5) EMA 9/21 crossover + RSI confirmation
Risk-percentage position sizing
ATR-based Stop Loss and trailing stop
Daily loss limit and max positions protection
Clickable dashboard to switch charts
Editable symbol list (default: AUDUSD, EURUSD, EURGBP, USDCHF, USDJPY, DJ30)
requirements: Algo Trading enabled on the chart
The chosen symbols must be available in your Market Watch

products.name: FVG Expert
products.shortDescription: Detects Fair Value Gaps on M5 and enters on M1 retracements with accurate risk sizing and break-even management.
products.overview: This Expert Advisor detects Fair Value Gaps (FVG) on the M5 timeframe and waits for price to retrace into them on M1 before entering. It continuously scans M5 candles to identify valid bullish and bearish Fair Value Gaps, draws the zones on the chart, and extends them dynamically as long as they remain valid. A trade is opened only when price returns into an active FVG on the M1 timeframe. Invalidated FVGs are automatically removed when broken by a closed M1 candle. Position size is calculated accurately based on risk percentage, and Stop Loss is moved to Break-Even once the trade reaches 1R profit.
features: Detects bullish and bearish Fair Value Gaps on M5
Enters on M1 retracement into the FVG zone
Automatically invalidates and removes broken FVGs
Dynamically extends active FVG boxes on the chart
Accurate risk-percentage position sizing
Moves Stop Loss to Break-Even at 1R
Works best on XAUUSD and major pairs
requirements: Algo Trading enabled on the chart

products.name: Limit Order Expert
products.shortDescription: Places Buy Limit and Sell Limit orders on real previous swing highs and lows with smart break-even management.
products.overview: This Expert Advisor scans hundreds of previous M1 bars to detect real swing highs and swing lows. It then places a Buy Limit on the nearest swing low below price and a Sell Limit on the nearest swing high above price. When a position opens, any opposite position is closed automatically. Once price reaches the first target, Stop Loss is moved to Break-Even while the full volume continues toward the final Take Profit. After the trade is closed, the EA rescans the market and places fresh limit orders. Clean, structured, and built for precise entries on gold.
features: Detects real previous swing highs and lows on M1
Places Buy Limit on nearest swing low and Sell Limit on nearest swing high
Automatically closes opposite position when a new trade opens
Moves Stop Loss to Break-Even at first target (full volume continues)
Risk-based lot size calculation
Modern on-chart panel with Daily P/L and live status
Works best on XAUUSD (Gold)
requirements: Any broker that allows pending orders
Algo Trading enabled on the chart

products.name: Buy Stop and Sell Stop Expert
products.shortDescription: Trades breakouts in both directions using buy stop and sell stop pending orders with smart reverse trailing.
products.overview: This Expert Advisor uses a reverse-pending strategy designed for gold (XAUUSD). At start, it places a Buy Stop above price and a Sell Stop below price. When one side is triggered and a position opens, the EA closes any opposite position and immediately places a new reverse pending order on the other side. The reverse pending order trails the price at a fixed distance, while the Stop Loss of the active position is continuously trailed behind it — locking in profits and keeping risk under control. Simple, systematic, and always ready for the next move.
features: Places buy stop and sell stop pending orders automatically
Automatically reverses and places the opposite pending order
Trails the reverse pending order with price movement
Trails Stop Loss behind the reverse pending order
Adjustable distance, lot size and trailing steps
Works best on XAUUSD (Gold)
requirements: Any broker that allows pending orders
Algo Trading enabled on the chart

products.name: 16-Symbol Quick Chart
products.shortDescription: Multi-symbol dashboard that monitors all trendlines and alerts when price touches support or resistance.
products.overview: A powerful multi-symbol dashboard that monitors every trendline on your charts — no naming or special color required. When price touches a trendline below the current price (support), the card turns Green and plays a sound alert. When price touches a trendline above (resistance), the card turns Red with an alert. The currently active chart is always highlighted in Gold. Each card shows the symbol, live price, status, and ATR. Click any card to instantly switch the chart to that symbol. Comes with a ready list of popular instruments including Gold, Silver, major Forex pairs, DJ30, and major cryptocurrencies — all fully editable. Also displays live floating P/L and margin level in the footer.
features: Monitors all trendlines — no naming or color required
Green alert when price touches support (line below)
Red alert when price touches resistance (line above)
Current chart card highlighted in Gold
Click any card to switch chart instantly
Live price, status, and ATR on every card
Sound alerts with adjustable cooldown
Floating P/L and margin level in the footer
Pre-loaded symbols: XAUUSD, XAGUSD, majors, DJ30, BTC, ETH and more
requirements: The symbols must be available in your Market Watch

products.name: Live Timeframe Candles
products.shortDescription: Multi-timeframe panel with live countdown timers and real-time mini candle previews on your chart.
products.overview: A clean and practical on-chart panel that gives you full control over all timeframes in one place. It displays a complete list of timeframes from M1 to Monthly and shows a live countdown for each one until the current candle closes. Click any timeframe button to instantly switch the chart. Toggle individual timeframes on or off to display live mini-candle previews with real-time OHLC values. Optional chart styling is also included for a cleaner candle appearance. Fast, lightweight, and designed for traders who want quick multi-timeframe awareness without opening multiple charts.
features: Full list of timeframes from M1 to Monthly
Live countdown timer for every timeframe
One-click switch to any timeframe
Toggleable live mini-candle previews with OHLC
Optional chart candle styling
Clean and customizable on-chart panel

products.name: TradingView Tools for MT5
products.shortDescription: Clean floating toolbar with TradingView-style drawing tools for MetaTrader 5.
products.overview: A clean, professional floating toolbar for MetaTrader 5 inspired by TradingView-style drawing tools. Fully draggable and minimizable panel that lets you draw Trend Lines, Zones, Fair Value Gaps (FVG), and Order Blocks with one or two clicks. Includes a Risk/Reward tool with correct calculation and fully movable and resizable boxes, Fibonacci retracement levels, and a Measure tool showing pips, bars, and percentage. Magnet mode for precise snapping to candle highs and lows, plus easy Select, Delete, and Clear All functions. Customizable colors and opacity for every tool. Fast, lightweight, and designed for traders who want professional charting tools without leaving MetaTrader 5.
